title: A tomato drops onto a wooden floor (rendered scene)
caption: The untrained Wan2.2 lets the tomato drift down slowly, as if in slow motion, and lifts it back into the air after it reaches the floor; MoPlan drops the tomato straight onto the floor, where it bounces slightly and comes to rest.
benchmark_detail: RigidBench evaluation sample 00077 (free fall), rendered scene

first_frame.faithful: pixel-identical copy of the generation input (PNG text and EXIF chunks removed)
first_frame.attribution: RigidBench evaluation set v1.1.0 (Swarnim Jain and Shangzhe Wu), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21649156, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); modified: PNG text and EXIF chunks removed, pixels unchanged

protocol.name: moprobe
protocol.image: RGB, resized to 448x256 with LANCZOS (stretched, no crop, no letterbox)

sampler.scheduler: UniPCMultistepScheduler of the Wan2.2 pipeline (flow shift 3.0)
sampler.guidance_note: the same scale is used for the high-noise and the low-noise expert

seed_rule: seed = 42 + (crc32(sample_id) mod 100000), seed index 0; both models use the same seed; the noise comes from torch.Generator('cuda').manual_seed(seed)
prompt_note: the generator prompt is the benchmark prompt followed by " Static shot with no camera movement.", which is appended when the benchmark text itself asks for a static camera
benchmark_prompt: A tomato is dropping. Static shot, locked-off camera, fixed tripod, stationary framing. No camera movement, no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no dolly, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time playback at natural speed, 24 fps, no slow motion, no time-lapse. Realistic rigid-body physics: gravity, momentum, friction, and collisions consistent with reality. Photorealistic, continuous single take, no cuts. Motion begins on the first frame.
regeneration_note: The reference hashes are of the 1280x704 mp4v evaluation exports, not of the files generate.py writes, so these two cases cannot be checked bit-for-bit with showcase.py verify; regeneration with generate.py has not been checked bit-for-bit.
